    Curriculum Vitae

    Executive Summary

    Research Assistant & Ph.D. Researcher at Texas Tech University specializing in AI-driven medical imaging, computer vision, and digital health diagnostics for metabolic disorders, fatty liver diseases (MASLD/NAFLD), and chronic health conditions. Holding M.Sc. and B.Sc. degrees in Computer Science and Engineering, he has authored peer-reviewed scientific publications (2,253+ citations, h-index: 25, i10-index: 48), edited 8 scholarly books with premier publishers (Springer, CRC Press, River Publishers / IEEE), and holds multiple granted patents. Serving as Associate Editor and Academic Editor across leading Q1/Q2 journals (Frontiers in Oncology, Discover Applied Sciences, PLOS ONE, PLOS Digital Health), his work bridges deep learning innovation with clinical workflow optimization to build scalable diagnostic tools and advance computational healthcare education.
